name: prediction-market
description: Oracle-settled prediction markets on Hedera: HTS position tokens, HIP-1215 self-scheduled settlement on Chainlink, optional Pyth fallback.

envVars.description: packages/nextjs/.env.local: JSON-RPC endpoint the frontend uses on Hedera testnet (default https://testnet.hashio.io/api).
packages/nextjs/.env.local: WalletConnect project id for RainbowKit. Without it the app offers MetaMask and the burner wallet only.
packages/nextjs/.env.local, optional, server-only: enables the Settle with Pyth fallback via the Next.js API route. The app runs fully without it.
packages/nextjs/.env.local, optional: overrides the Pyth Hermes endpoint (default https://hermes.pyth.network).
packages/nextjs/.env.local, optional: HCS topic for public settlement records. Create one with node packages/nextjs/scripts/createRecordTopic.mjs.
packages/nextjs/.env.local, optional, server-only: Hedera account (0.0.x) that pays for publishing settlement records.
packages/nextjs/.env.local, optional, server-only: private key of HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID. Never prefix it with NEXT_PUBLIC_.
Funded testnet ECDSA key for the end-to-end lifecycle check (DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY=0x... yarn foundry:e2e:testnet). Automation only, never commit it.

steps.text: Open http://localhost:3000. The app ships pointing at a live testnet deployment, so it works before you deploy anything.

steps.label: Generate or import a deployer account

steps.text: Get testnet HBAR at https://portal.hedera.com (1000 HBAR per day; a market needs about 30 HBAR).
Run the lifecycle check: DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY=0x... yarn foundry:e2e:testnet (about 17 minutes, prints Hashscan links).
Read How it works in the README (lifecycle diagram, first-round-at-or-after-expiry rule, HIP-1215 retries, tinybar units), then AGENTS.md for invariants and safe extension points.
